# The Claude layer as copied from mark-brannan/dotfiles. Paths are dotfiles
# paths; this repo's root is ~/.claude, so drift.py maps .claude/X to X,
# .local/bin/X to bin/X and .config/systemd/user/X to systemd/X. drift.py
# (beside this file) reads it; see its docstring for the mapping, the layout
# rewrites and what is red.
#
#   root <dir/>   every tracked file under it, in either repo, is listed below
#   copy <path>   in both repos, equal to dotfiles main after layout rewrites
#   skip <path>   on dotfiles main under a root, deliberately not copied
#   own  <path>   only in this repo, under a root; a path in THIS repo's
#                 layout, and one ending in / covers everything under it
#
# Not copied, and outside the roots so not checked:
#   .github/workflows/claude-code-review.yml   this repo has its own brief
#   .github/workflows/claude-config-action-smoke.yml   seeds dotfiles at the
#       pull request's own head SHA, which exists only in dotfiles
#   .github/workflows/churn-guard.yml   dotfiles' own churn budget
#   ci.yml jobs shellcheck, seeded, guard-tests, tool-tests: ported into this
#       repo's ci.yml, minus what tests dotfiles alone

root .claude/
root .local/bin/
root .config/systemd/user/
root .github/actions/claude-config/
root docs/

# Repo scaffolding: .claude/ is a root and maps to this repo's whole root, so
# everything that is not the layer itself is listed here. It lands in
# ~/.claude too, where Claude Code ignores it.
own .editorconfig
own .github/dotfiles-drift/
own .github/workflows/
own .gitignore
own .mergify.yml
own README.md
